g.text: Task 5: End-to-End Data Wiring • SMS Ingestion ➔ AI Classification ➔ Storage ➔ Coordinator Command Center
AI never auto-purges reports. Flagged tickets require coordinator verification.
Actions: [Dismiss Spam] OR [Verify as Real Incident]
SQLAlchemy ORM Mapping with Strict Type Constraints
id UUID PK, text TEXT, phone VARCHAR,
lat FLOAT, lng FLOAT, category ENUM,
urgency ENUM, status ENUM, created_at TIME
• Urgency Color Pins: Red / Orange / Green
• Detail Popup Cards on Marker Selection
5. INTEGRATION, VALIDATION & DEMO DEPLOYMENT LAYER (Task 5 Lead)
• UUID Compliance, Enum Verification & Priority Sort
• Real-World Urban Flood Simulation (Bhopal GPS Grid)
• Evaluators can post distress messages directly from phone
